name: Decorous Investment And Trading Co Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1982, Decorous Investment 
and Trading Company Ltd deals in Real Estate, 
Consulting, Agents, and Distributors, etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
DITCL is in the business of investment and trading. It carries out the business activities relating to real estate, debentures, securities, 
commission, agents, brokers, gems & jewellery, consultancy, trading/purchase & sale 
of bullion & commodities, service providers, etc.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 2.71% over last 3 years.
